pose: TALL_MEASURE framing. The Tropeognathus stands tall, showing off the large, keel-like crests on the tips of both its upper and lower jaws. The upper crest aligns with the top of the frame for maximum vertical scale.

environmental_details.ground: Reddish-brown mud with shallow turquoise pools.
environmental_details.flora: Early lily-pads (Angiosperms) scattered in the lagoon water.
